# Dovail Stay

> Dovail Stay is an accommodation and travel marketplace for discovering homes, trips, and local services.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://stay.dovail.com/): Browse featured homes and search for stays.
- [Trips and experiences](https://stay.dovail.com/experiences): Browse available travel experiences.
- [Services](https://stay.dovail.com/services): Discover local services.
- [Help Center](https://stay.dovail.com/help): Find help with bookings, hosting, payments, and accounts.
- [Support](https://stay.dovail.com/support): Contact Dovail Stay support.

## Policies and discovery

- [Privacy Policy](https://stay.dovail.com/privacy): How Dovail Stay handles personal information.
- [Terms of Service](https://stay.dovail.com/terms): Terms governing use of Dovail Stay.
- [Sitemap](https://stay.dovail.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical public URLs for stays, experiences, services, and informational pages.

Public catalog pages may be indexed. Account, checkout, booking, messaging, host-management, and administrative pages require user context and should not be treated as public reference material.
